hints: How is a PAGE related to a BOOK?
Make a bridge sentence: "A page is one part of a book."
Now say: "A petal is one part of a ___." Test each choice. Pick the thing that a petal belongs to directly.

solution.methodName: Make a bridge sentence, then test each choice

steps.action: Make a bridge sentence: "A page is one part of a book."
steps.why: A book is made of many pages. The page is the part and the book is the whole.

steps.action: Use the same bridge: "A petal is one part of a ___."
steps.why: A petal is one of the soft, colored pieces around the center of a flower.

steps.action: Test each choice. A petal is one part of a flower. It is not part of a leaf or a stem, and a garden is a place where flowers grow.

trapNotes.leaf: A leaf is another part of a plant. A petal is not a part of a leaf, so the bridge fails.
trapNotes.garden: A garden is a place where flowers grow. A petal belongs to a flower, not directly to a garden.
trapNotes.stem: The stem is another part of the plant: the stalk that holds the flower up. A petal is not part of the stem.
